correctness.rationale: Ostrovski establishes the invariant polygon Γ_K^0 and rotation order for each exceptional θ_K, K≥3. With t=sin²θ, s=sinθcosθ, v_j=B^j(t,1−s), det B=1 makes det(v_j,v_{j+1})=−t(1−2s) for all K sides. Centered shoelace over four quarter-turn copies telescopes to area(U_K)=1−2t−2Kt(1−2s), giving the exact ε expression. The preserved indefinite Q and endpoint B^Kv0=Rv0 imply cosh(Kμ)=1/(2t), while cosh μ=1+2 sin³ ε/(cos ε−sin ε), hence K=ε^−1+1/3+O(ε), ε_K=K^−1+(1/3)K^−2+O(K^−3). Leading O(ε) terms in area cancel, leaving 10/(3K²)+O(K^−3). Independent 65-digit bisection solved parameter relation for K=3,4,8,12,25,100,500, checked two algebraic area expressions, and found K² area converging toward 3.333... . Source establishes Jordan boundary and annulus foliation; this result does not claim dynamics of the residual region.
